description: Execute + Report: sua loi (Batch 1-3) + docs sync + verification loop + final report. Phase 3 (CRITICAL→HIGH→MEDIUM), Phase 4 (Docs Sync + Stub Creation), Phase 5 (State Machine Verify Loop, max 3 iterations), Phase 6 (Report — dry-run cung chay day du). v3.0.0: tach thanh 10 procedure files + _shared.md (lazy loading, giam ~70% context load). v3.1.0: fix 5 bugs — VERIFY_INIT iteration owner, e2e-results.json UPDATE-only, stale ref, fix-status.json contract, CQG numeric verify. v3.2.0 (S3 wf-fix-bugs v7.0): fix-plan.md + fix-log.json templates di chuyen sang _shared/lane/templates/ (F3 fix). v3.3.0 (S8): Phase 4a hook docs-crossref check (soft warn — `wf-fix-docs-crossref.sh` → docs-sync-report.json), Phase 6 pre-POST-GATE CQG hard-enforce (`wf-fix-cqg-verify.sh` → cqg-verify.json, mismatch >5% → POST-GATE FAIL E001). v3.6.0 (Phase A v8 Honest Framing): Phase 6 Step 6.0c compute coverage-estimate.json qua `aggregate.coverage_estimator`; fix-report.md template them section Coverage Estimate voi blind-spots + recommendations + disclaimer KHONG dam bao 100% coverage.

prerequisites.notes: 3 files REQUIRED + 1 optional (impact-graph.json). issue-registry.json phai co severity set (da qua Phase 2 triage) + blast_radius field (ADR-22 rule 2). impact-graph.json (schema impact-graph.v1) — optional, can thiet cho Verify Ripple (step 5.1b) neu available. fix-status.json.phases.phase_2.status phai == 'completed'. Dry-run mode: SKIP Phase 3-5 (bao gom Verify Ripple), chay ngay Phase 6. v6 mode: detect via fix-status.json.engine_version == 'v6' — khi v6, issue-registry.json co v2 schema (dimensions_run, coverage, dedup_stats); execute van fix + verify binh thuong.

Best-effort — fail khong block skill. KHONG dung file nay lam input/context cho skill khac (CORE-026). Chi tiet: procedures/_shared.md §Execution Trace Protocol.

v3.3.0 S8 — Bidirectional docs sync verification (schema docs-sync-report-v1). Generated by Phase 4a hook qua `bash scripts/wf-fix-docs-crossref.sh --session-dir $SESSION_DIR`. 2 mismatch types: missing_git_diff (fix-log claims update doc nhung git khong thay), orphan_git_change (git change feature/UX spec nhung khong co fix-log). SOFT WARNING — KHONG block POST-GATE (status: passed | warning | skipped). Consumed boi wf-verify-sync (--from-fix-bugs S9) cross-check Phase 5b UI coverage. Graceful exit 0 khi git unavailable hoac fix-log empty.

v3.3.0 S8 — CQG numeric metric verification (schema wf-fix-cqg-verify-v1). Generated by Phase 6 pre-POST-GATE hook qua `bash scripts/wf-fix-cqg-verify.sh --session-dir $SESSION_DIR`. 3 metrics: issues_fixed_count, files_modified_count, coverage_pct (compare claims trong fix-report.md vs ground truth fix-log + issue-registry). Tolerance ±5% mac dinh, configurable qua env MCV3_FIX_CQG_TOLERANCE_PCT. HARD ENFORCE — script exit 3 (passed=false) → POST-GATE FAIL E001 (CQG_NUMERIC_MISMATCH). fail_required_cdg=true → render CDG (Protocol 16) hoi user accept|reject|modify. Reject → quay lai Phase 6 sua fix-report. Inline schema, runtime-computed.

v3.6.0 (Phase A v8 — Honest Framing). Schema coverage-estimate-v1. Generated by Phase 6 Step 6.0c qua `python3 -m aggregate.coverage_estimator --session $SESSION_DIR`. Fields: stack, profile, dimensions_enabled, llm_scan_enabled, components{stack_base_pct, profile_multiplier, dimension_coverage_pct, static_estimate_pct, llm_bonus_pct}, coverage_estimate_pct (capped 95%), confidence (high|medium|low), blind_spots[], recommendations[], disclaimer. Doc fix-status.json (profile, dimensions, flags.llm_scan) + optional stack-info.json (Phase B Stack-Aware). Consumed boi Step 6.1 Report Generation Detail de fill {{COVERAGE_*}} placeholders trong fix-report.md template. Module crash → log warning, KHONG fail Phase 6 (graceful degradation).
